verses.original: Πόθεν πόλεμοι καὶ πόθεν μάχαι ἐν ὑμῖν οὐκ ἐντεῦθεν ἐκ ὑμῶν τῶν ἡδονῶν τῶν στρατευομένων ἐν ὑμῶν τοῖς μέλεσιν
verses.transliteration: Pothen polemoi kai pothen machai en hymin ouk enteuthen ek hymōn tōn hēdonōn tōn strateuomenōn en hymōn tois melesin
verses.literal: What [causes] conflicts and - quarrels among you Don’t [they] [come] from [the] - passions - at war within you . . . . . .

verses.original: ἐπιθυμεῖτε καὶ οὐκ ἔχετε φονεύετε καὶ ζηλοῦτε καὶ οὐ δύνασθε ἐπιτυχεῖν μάχεσθε καὶ πολεμεῖτε οὐκ ἔχετε διὰ ὑμᾶς μὴ τὸ αἰτεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: epithymeite kai ouk echete phoneuete kai zēloute kai ou dynasthe epitychein machesthe kai polemeite ouk echete dia hymas mē to aiteisthai
verses.literal: You crave [what] {you do} not have you kill and covet but vvv are unable to obtain [it] You quarrel and fight vvv You do not have because you {do} not - ask

verses.original: αἰτεῖτε καὶ οὐ λαμβάνετε διότι αἰτεῖσθε κακῶς ἵνα δαπανήσητε ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς ἡδοναῖς
verses.transliteration: aiteite kai ou lambanete dioti aiteisthe kakōs hina dapanēsēte en hymōn tais hēdonais
verses.literal: [And when] you do ask . . . {you do} not receive because you ask with wrong motives that you may squander [it] on your - pleasures

verses.original: Μοιχαλίδες οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἡ φιλία τοῦ κόσμου ἐστιν ἔχθρα τοῦ Θεοῦ οὖν ὃς ἐὰν βουληθῇ εἶναι φίλος τοῦ κόσμου καθίσταται ἐχθρὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Moichalides ouk oidate hoti hē philia tou kosmou estin echthra tou Theou oun hos ean boulēthē einai philos tou kosmou kathistatai echthros tou Theou
verses.literal: [You] adulteresses vvv Do you not know that - friendship with the world is hostility [toward] God Therefore whoever . . . chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy - of God

verses.original: ἢ δοκεῖτε ὅτι ἡ γραφὴ λέγει κενῶς τὸ πνεῦμα ὃ κατῴκισεν ἐν ἡμῖν ἐπιποθεῖ Πρὸς φθόνον
verses.transliteration: ē dokeite hoti hē graphē legei kenōs to pneuma ho katōkisen en hēmin epipothei Pros phthonon
verses.literal: Or do you think - the Scripture says without reason [that] the Spirit - He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy

verses.original: δὲ δίδωσιν μείζονα χάριν διὸ λέγει Ὁ Θεὸς ἀντιτάσσεται ὑπερηφάνοις δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν ταπεινοῖς
verses.transliteration: de didōsin meizona charin dio legei Ho Theos antitassetai hyperēphanois de didōsin charin tapeinois
verses.literal: But He gives [us] more grace This is why it says - God opposes [the] proud but gives grace to [the] humble

verses.original: Ὑποτάγητε οὖν τῷ Θεῷ δὲ ἀντίστητε τῷ διαβόλῳ καὶ φεύξεται ἀφ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hypotagēte oun tō Theō de antistēte tō diabolō kai pheuxetai aph’ hymōn
verses.literal: Submit yourselves then - to God - Resist the devil and he will flee from you

verses.original: ἐγγίσατε τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐγγιεῖ ὑμῖν καθαρίσατε χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλοί καὶ ἁγνίσατε καρδίας δίψυχοι
verses.transliteration: engisate tō Theō kai engiei hymin katharisate cheiras hamartōloi kai hagnisate kardias dipsychoi
verses.literal: Draw near - to God and He will draw near to you Cleanse [your] hands [you] sinners and purify [your] hearts [you] double-minded

verses.original: ταλαιπωρήσατε καὶ πενθήσατε καὶ κλαύσατε μετατραπήτω ὑμῶν ὁ γέλως εἰς πένθος καὶ ἡ χαρὰ εἰς κατήφειαν
verses.transliteration: talaipōrēsate kai penthēsate kai klausate metatrapētō hymōn ho gelōs eis penthos kai hē chara eis katēpheian
verses.literal: Grieve - mourn and weep Turn your - laughter to mourning and [your] joy to gloom

verses.original: ταπεινώθητε ἐνώπιον Κυρίου καὶ ὑψώσει ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: tapeinōthēte enōpion Kyriou kai hypsōsei hymas
verses.literal: Humble yourselves before [the] Lord and He will exalt you

verses.original: ἀδελφοί Μὴ καταλαλεῖτε ἀλλήλων ὁ καταλαλῶν ἀδελφοῦ ἢ κρίνων αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν καταλαλεῖ νόμου καὶ κρίνει νόμον δὲ εἰ κρίνεις νόμον εἶ οὐκ ποιητὴς νόμου ἀλλὰ κριτής
verses.transliteration: adelphoi Mē katalaleite allēlōn ho katalalōn adelphou ē krinōn autou ton adelphon katalalei nomou kai krinei nomon de ei krineis nomon ei ouk poiētēs nomou alla kritēs
verses.literal: Brothers {do} not slander one another Anyone who speaks against [his] brother or judges vvv vvv [him] speaks against [the] law and judges [it] And if you judge [the] law you are not a practitioner of [the] law but a judge [of it]

verses.original: ἐστιν ὁ εἷς νομοθέτης καὶ κριτής ὁ δυνάμενος σῶσαι καὶ ἀπολέσαι δὲ τίς εἶ σὺ ὁ κρίνων τὸν πλησίον
verses.transliteration: estin ho heis nomothetēs kai kritēs ho dynamenos sōsai kai apolesai de tis ei sy ho krinōn ton plēsion
verses.literal: There is - only one Lawgiver and Judge the [One who] is able to save and destroy But who are you - to judge [your] neighbor

verses.original: Ἄγε νῦν οἱ λέγοντες Σήμερον ἢ αὔριον πορευσόμεθα εἰς τήνδε τὴν πόλιν καὶ ποιήσομεν ἐνιαυτὸν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἐμπορευσόμεθα καὶ κερδήσομεν
verses.transliteration: Age nyn hoi legontes Sēmeron ē aurion poreusometha eis tēnde tēn polin kai poiēsomen eniauton ekei kai emporeusometha kai kerdēsomen
verses.literal: Come now you who say Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that - city - spend a year there - carry on business and make a profit

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐπίστασθε οὐκ τὸ τῆς αὔριον ποία ὑμῶν ἡ ζωὴ γάρ ἐστε ἀτμὶς πρὸς ἡ φαινομένη ὀλίγον καὶ ἔπειτα ἀφανιζομένη
verses.transliteration: hoitines epistasthe ouk to tēs aurion poia hymōn hē zōē gar este atmis pros hē phainomenē oligon kai epeita aphanizomenē
verses.literal: You do not even know . . . what [will happen] vvv tomorrow What [is] your - life - You are a mist vvv vvv that appears for a little [while] and then vanishes

verses.original: Ἀντὶ ὑμᾶς τοῦ λέγειν Ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος θελήσῃ καὶ ζήσομεν καὶ ποιήσομεν τοῦτο ἢ ἐκεῖνο
verses.transliteration: Anti hymas tou legein Ean ho Kyrios thelēsē kai zēsomen kai poiēsomen touto ē ekeino
verses.literal: Instead you [ought] - to say If the Lord is willing - we will live and do this or that

verses.original: δὲ νῦν καυχᾶσθε ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς ἀλαζονείαις πᾶσα τοιαύτη καύχησις ἐστιν πονηρά
verses.transliteration: de nyn kauchasthe en hymōn tais alazoneiais pasa toiautē kauchēsis estin ponēra
verses.literal: vvv As it is you boast in your - proud intentions All such boasting is evil

verses.original: αὐτῷ οὖν εἰδότι καλὸν ποιεῖν καὶ μὴ ποιοῦντι ἐστιν ἁμαρτία
verses.transliteration: autō oun eidoti kalon poiein kai mē poiounti estin hamartia
verses.literal: Anyone then who knows [the] right thing to do yet fails to do [it] is guilty of sin
